facts.authoredFrom: Read from the case's input bytes: grund.toml writes no `grund_config_version`, which selects the version-1 reader (§FS-config.5) and so earns the version caution all the same (§FS-config.5.3), and `[reference] strict = true`, the default mode, with default marker `§`, kinds and scan, so docs/ is read (§FS-config.3.1, §FS-config.3.5). In strict mode only marker-prefixed tokens are citations and a bare ID-shaped token is plain text that raises no dangling finding (§FS-citations.recognized): FS-001-alpha's line 3 cites §FS-002-beta, while its bare FS-999-missing is neither a citation nor a finding nor a query; FS-002-beta's line 3 cites §FS-001-alpha. The FS home is docs/functional-spec/ and its index the default README.md (§FS-config.3.4.2); it holds both entries as full links whose destinations already name each declaration's own heading anchor (§FS-check.3.18, §FS-fmt.6.2.1, §FS-fmt.6.2.2: `# FS-001-alpha: Alpha` slugifies to fs-001-alpha-alpha, `# FS-002-beta: Beta` to fs-002-beta-beta), so no index finding arises and the index pass re-derives nothing (§FS-fmt.6.3); the index's citations sit under no declaration (its `# FS index` heading declares nothing). The bare ID-shaped text inside each link destination is no citation (§FS-citations.recognized.link-destinations), a heading's own ID is no citation (§FS-citations.recognized.title-lines), and `FS` alone is no ID. Each declaration's body runs from line 2 to the file's last line 4, a blank one, with no section heading (§FS-show.2.1.2, §FS-list.3.4.1). Both declarations are cited, every citation resolves, so the only finding is the site-less version caution (§FS-check.checks.config-version-1, §FS-config.5.3). FS-404 is the absent control. Cross-reference emission is on by default (§FS-config.3.7, §FS-fmt.6.7.2), so each marked prose citation is wrapped to its declaration's heading (§FS-fmt.6.2.1), one link per line; the bare FS-999-missing is no citation and is left as written, and without --marker no bare token is marked (§FS-fmt.2.2, §FS-fmt.6.5). The dry run lists and the write applies the same two rewrites.

findings.message: grund.toml is version 1; migrate it with grund config migrate --to 2

docs/functional-spec/FS-001-alpha.md.3: Marker reference [§FS-002-beta](FS-002-beta.md#fs-002-beta-beta). Bare missing token FS-999-missing is ignored.
